facts.what: 写日记时夺回叙事控制，故事不被他人扭曲
facts.anchor: In this moment, she is completely in control of the narrative.

facts.what: 希望逃出鸟笼但自知靠己无力；有时祈祷他快点下狠手，好结束
facts.anchor: Sometimes she prays that he would hurry up and do his worst.

facts.what: 承诺圣诞集市、摩天轮、滑冰，最终全落空；她认定他惯常撒谎
facts.anchor: But he lied as, I’ve realised now, he so often does.

facts.what: 买两杯热红酒时对女调酒师 wink，转身对她落脸并因价格发怒
facts.anchor: he erupted into a childlike tantrum about the price

facts.what: 被催出门没吃早饭、无钱买食；他戴耳机屏蔽她
facts.anchor: my voice seemed too unbearable for him, and he whipped out his earphones and blocked me out

facts.what: 火车到站他先下车不回头；她后悔没跟人群跑掉
facts.anchor: she wishes she’d made a run for it with the other passengers when she had the chance

facts.what: 钥匙开门声，她急把日记塞到沙发底座下
facts.anchor: thrusts it under the base of the couch

relations: 她与「他」同游爱丁堡圣诞集市后返回格拉斯哥；她受其财务与情绪控制
numbers: 到格拉斯哥前约十五分钟（text:28）
